load_brier_score_metric: load the brier_score metric module using evaluate.load with the metric name string
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive Gradio widget for the brier_score metric evaluation module
run_brier_score_evaluation: run the brier_score metric evaluation on predictions and labels via the loaded module
compute_brier_score: compute the brier score metric for probabilistic predictions against true labels
evaluate_metric_module: evaluate a huggingface metric module loaded via evaluate.load for scoring predictions
